messages:
alex.h: Hey — opened a PR to roll out the user-metadata batching feature flag. It touches runtime/flags/feature_toggles.yaml and product/feature_flags/README.md. CI passed, but not sure who should approve/merge since it spans runtime + product.
morgan: Can you paste the relevant CODEOWNERS lines? last time we got tripped up by pattern order.
alex.h: sure — here's the parts that matter:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/runtime/ @eng-runtime
/product/ @product-team
/docs/ @docs-team
```
The PR modifies /runtime/flags/feature_toggles.yaml (adds one flag) and a tiny doc in /product/feature_flags/README.md (one sentence explaining behavior).
rita.k: Since runtime/ is owned by eng-runtime, someone from that team needs to approve the runtime change. Product owns the doc, but that's minor. If the runtime change is non-functional (only adding a flag entry) runtime oncall could approve. @morgan do we have an oncall list for runtime owners?
ben: We do have a rotation. But fwiw repo admins can merge even without CODEOWNER approvals if they add a label `codeowner-override`. Prefer to avoid overrides unless it's urgent.
morgan: +1 to avoid overrides. Alex — is this gated by any rollout script or infra that eng-platform owns? If not, then runtime approval should be sufficient. If the PR also touches runtime bootstrap or rollout config (which eng-platform owns) we need eng-platform signoff.
alex.h: no infra changes — just the flag file and doc. I'll reword the doc to minimize the product touch if that helps.
deploy-bot: CI: ✅ checks passed (unit tests, lint), integration: ✅, deploy preview: available at https://deploy-preview/1234 :rocket:
rita.k: I can take a look — if it's just adding an entry to the YAML and the doc tweak, I can approve. I'm runtime oncall today.
ben: Thanks rita — once you approve I'll merge, unless you want to land it.
rita.k: I'll approve and leave the merge to whoever is comfortable. Quick note: please include a changelog entry so we can track toggles in release notes.
alex.h: done — added changelog line and bumped the feature_toggles.yaml comment. tagging you @rita.k for review.
rita.k: Approved :white_check_mark:
alex.h: thanks! merging now. Will monitor logs for 30m after rollout. :eyes:
